messages:
maria: kicking off a focused quant bakeoff for long-context workloads. goal: compare baseline FP16 -> GPTQ, AWQ, and a SmoothQuant+AWQ mix on 64k and 48k profiles. hardware: 8xA100-80C per pool. tagging @cheng @aj for perf knobs. :rocket:
aj: nice — for clarity: are we keeping kv-cache eviction off for the 64k runs? last time eviction caused noisy throughput numbers.
maria: starting runs with kv-cache eviction=on for 48k, and off for 64k to isolate behavior. logs will be in /runs/2026-03/1769200000.
cheng: noted. I'm particularly interested in per-layer activation drifts with SmoothQuant at the head layers. if we see >0.8% ppl increase on synth long-tail, we should abort that config.
lina: pushed a small change to the runner to capture per-step token latency and kv-cache footprint. command I'm using:```bash
python bakeoff.py --model redwood/rl-model-3b --ctx 65536 --quant_configs "[fp16,gptq,awq,smooth+awq]" --batch 1 --runs 3 --outdir /runs/2026-03/1769200000
```
aj: thanks. also enable --sample-seed=42 and use the longspan eval set (longspan-v2, 10k prompts). will make deltas comparable.
maria: eval-bot started posting intermediate metrics. first round (48k, kv-evict=on):
```
results/48k/round1.txt
FP16   - ppl: 12.02   rougeL: 0.421  latency_tok_ms: 9.8
GPTQ   - ppl: 12.35   rougeL: 0.413  latency_tok_ms: 7.2
AWQ    - ppl: 12.18   rougeL: 0.419  latency_tok_ms: 6.9
Smooth+AWQ - ppl: 12.22 rougeL: 0.416 latency_tok_ms: 7.1
```
cheng: interesting — GPTQ latency wins but ppl jump is noticeable. AWQ and Smooth+AWQ are closer to FP16 on quality, with ~0.1-0.2 ppl delta. those are within threshold.
aj: any stability issues? memory OOMs?
maria: one transient OOM when batch prefetcher overlapped KV writes on node-3. I killed that run and requeued with prefetcher=0. node-3 logs:```
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory when allocating 1.2G for kv_block
```
lina: re-run green. also added a small hack to preemptively shrink kv stripe when token stream goes beyond 48k. not ideal but helps with these experiments.
eval-bot: posted summary for 64k (kv-evict=off):
```
results/64k/summary.txt
FP16        - ppl: 13.45  rougeL: 0.392  tok_lat_ms: 11.8  cpu%: 18
GPTQ        - ppl: 14.60  rougeL: 0.376  tok_lat_ms: 8.0   cpu%: 22
AWQ         - ppl: 13.62  rougeL: 0.389  tok_lat_ms: 7.6   cpu%: 21
Smooth+AWQ  - ppl: 13.58  rougeL: 0.391  tok_lat_ms: 7.8   cpu%: 20
accuracy_delta vs FP16: GPTQ -1.15 ppl, AWQ -0.17 ppl, Smooth+AWQ -0.13 ppl
```
maria: Smooth+AWQ looks promising for 64k — small accuracy delta and ~35% token-latency reduction vs FP16. big win for cost. :money_with_wings:
cheng: can we get per-layer activation scale factors? I'd like to see where SmoothQuant applied the heaviest rescaling.
lina: uploading the layer_scales csv to runs/1769200000/artifacts. quick peek: top 3 scaled layers are blocks.2.mlp.fc1, blocks.5.attn.o, blocks.8.mlp.fc2.
aj: does that line up with the activation histograms? last time we saw head-layer saturation in block.2 causing underflow when combined with AWQ.
maria: hmm, for Smooth+AWQ the histograms look slightly compressed but not clipped. attaching a tiny snippet:```
block.2.mlp.fc1 - fp16 peak: 3.1, awq_quant_peak: 2.9, smooth_scale: 0.85
block.5.attn.o - fp16 peak: 2.6, awq_quant_peak: 2.6, smooth_scale: 0.88
```
cheng: good. next step: run an ablation where we only apply SmoothQuant to the top-k offending layers (k=3) vs global SmoothQuant. see if that recovers the remaining micro-delta while retaining latency gains.
maria: queued the ablation: SmoothTop3+AWQ for 64k. ETA ~ 2.5h.
eval-bot: ablation result (SmoothTop3+AWQ):```
FP16  - ppl: 13.45
SmoothTop3+AWQ - ppl: 13.52  rougeL: 0.390 tok_lat_ms: 7.85
accuracy_delta: +0.07 ppl vs FP16 (within target); latency ~34% lower
```
aj: that looks like the sweet spot. small quality loss, big latency win. can we add rollout policy for Dedicated where we prefer SmoothTop3+AWQ if traffic is >100 qps?
cheng: also run a stress of KV eviction toggles under real request mix. regression can hide in flaky eviction windows.
lina: adding automated canary script to console that compares SmoothTop3+AWQ vs FP16 on the live longspan subset for 30m windows. will trigger rollback on ppl delta >0.5.
maria: final notes: create a short doc with recommended quant profile (SmoothTop3+AWQ for longctx >= 48k) and include knobs: kv-evict policy, prefetcher=0, preemptive kv shrink. I'll draft and ping for reviews.
achj: (typo) meant @aj.
aj: :thumbsup: please also include cost-per-token estimates and expected throughput uplift. I can help model the economics for Dedicated.
maria: thanks team, will post draft in #eng-ml later today. end thread.
